name: Pinball Arcade: Firepower
storyline: Firepower (1980): is another classic design from the "King of Flow", Steve Ritchie. This outer space themed table won multiple awards including "Best Producer", "Best Special Effects" and "Best Performance". It was the first solid state table to feature Multi-Ball and included many industry first features that would go on to become pinball standards. These include the first animated displays, first electronic Multi-Ball and the first use of a player controlled, Lane Change. 17,410 units of this table were produced.
